command: cd /tmp && sed -n "$(grep -n '  \/api\/integrations:' openapi.yaml | cut -d: -f1),+45p" openapi.yaml | head -50; echo ===TEST; sed -n "$(grep -n '  \/api\/integrations\/test:' openapi.yaml | cut -d: -f1),+35p" openapi.yaml

data:
/api/integrations:
    get:
      tags: [integrations]
      operationId: listIntegrations
      summary: The integrations this server offers, and the caller's connections
      description: |
        `providers` is what the admin switched on with `INTEGRATIONS` (empty when it is unset,
        the default), `connections` the caller's own. A connection never carries a secret or
        its full URL: `info.url` is masked. `status` is `connected`, `paused` or `attention`
        (the last deliveries failed for good, or its sealed settings no longer open because
        `./data/secret` changed); `lastError` says why in plain words.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Providers and connections.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  providers:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id: { type: string, example: webhook }
                        kind: { type: string, enum: [webhook, apikey, oauth] }
                        category: { type: string, example: automation }
                        events: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/IntegrationEvent' } }
                        max: { type: integer, description: Connections of this kind a profile may have. }
                        lan: { type: boolean, description: 'Present (true) when INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_LAN=1: home-network receivers are allowed.' }
                  connections:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/IntegrationConnection' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }

  /api/integrations/connect:
    post:
      tags: [integrations]
      operationId: connectIntegration
      summary: Add a connection (a webhook)
      description: |
        For `provider: webhook`: `url` (https, or http to a home-network address when
        `INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_LAN=1`; never loopback, link-local or, by default, a private
        address), an optional `label` (60 characters) and `events` (at least one; default
        `workout.finished`). At most 10 webhooks a profile. The answer's `reveal.secret` is
        the signing secret, **shown this once**: the server keeps it sealed and never sends

===TEST
  /api/integrations/test:
    post:
      tags: [integrations]
      operationId: testIntegration
      summary: Send a test event now
      description: >-
        Delivers a made-up event of `type` (default: the connection's first event) straight
        away, marked `"test": true`, and answers how it went. Six a minute per profile.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [id]
              properties:
                id: { type: string }
                type: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/IntegrationEvent' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The receiver's answer (`ok` false with `msg` when it failed).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ok: { type: boolean }
                  status: { type: ['integer', 'null'], description: The receiver's HTTP status. }
                  ms: { type: ['integer', 'null'] }
                  msg: { type: ['string', 'null'] }
                  connection: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/IntegrationConnection' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/IntegrationsOff' }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/IntegrationsSlowDown' }

  /api/integrations/retry:
